statements.t: Due to anticipated remediation expenses, interruption in retail sales during the fourth quarter, retailer returns, and near-term demand uncertainty resulting from this camera cable guard safety update, the Company is withdrawing its previously issued full year 2026 financial outlook.

Additional details will be provided in the Company’s upcoming Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q filing for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, and the accompanying conference call and webcast held today.

The Company’s non-GAAP financial measures should not be considered as an alternative to net income (loss) or net income (loss) per share as a measure of financial performance or any other performance measure derived in accordance with GAAP and should not be construed as an inference that the Company’s future results will be unaffected by unusual or non-recurring items.

statements.t: We estimate the total cost of the program at $13 million to $18 million, the majority of which we expect to incur in the fourth quarter of 2026.

We expect the program, including the return of units held by retailers, to materially reduce our fourth quarter 2026 net revenue, gross margin and cash flows, and we expect the camera cable guard safety update of stop-sale to adversely affect demand for our products, including during the 2026 holiday season.

Revenue is recognized when control of goods and services is transferred to customers in an amount that reflects the consideration expected to be received by us in exchange for those goods and services.

Non-GAAP financial measures should not be considered as an alternative to net loss as a measure of financial performance or any other performance measure derived in accordance with GAAP, and should not be construed as an inference that our future results will be unaffected by unusual or non-recurring items.

There can be no assurance that we will generate sufficient future cash flows from operations due to potential factors, including but not limited to inflation, recession, or reduced demand for our products.
We will continue to monitor developments in this area and take actions to mitigate potential impacts as appropriate.

See Note 4 within the Notes to Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements included elsewhere in this Report and refer to our Annual Report on Form 10-K filed with the SEC on March 9, 2026 for additional details regarding our debt arrangements, including the expected maturity of such arrangements.

For both the nine months ended September 30, 2026 and September 30, 2025, we used $2,013 and $454, respectively, to invest in various projects, primarily for property and equipment and the development and enhancement of our subscription app.
The Company will continue to evaluate the impact of these provisions on our 2026 and subsequent financial statements.
